targets.rawSQL: SELECT COUNT(*) AS succeeded FROM pipeline_run_summary WHERE UPPER(status) IN ('SUCCESS', 'SUCCEEDED') AND created_at >= (SELECT MAX(created_at) - INTERVAL '30' DAY FROM pipeline_run_summary)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS failed FROM pipeline_run_summary WHERE UPPER(status) IN ('FAILED', 'FAILURE', 'ERROR') AND created_at >= (SELECT MAX(created_at) - INTERVAL '30' DAY FROM pipeline_run_summary)

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(status) IN ('SUCCESS', 'SUCCEEDED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*) * 100 AS success_rate FROM pipeline_run_summary WHERE created_at >= (SELECT MAX(created_at) - INTERVAL '30' DAY FROM pipeline_run_summary)
SELECT AVG(duration_sec) AS avg_duration FROM pipeline_run_summary WHERE created_at >= (SELECT MAX(created_at) - INTERVAL '30' DAY FROM pipeline_run_summary)

SELECT created_at AS time, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(status) IN ('SUCCESS', 'SUCCEEDED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS succeeded, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(status) IN ('FAILED', 'FAILURE', 'ERROR') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed FROM pipeline_run_summary WHERE created_at >= (SELECT MAX(created_at) - INTERVAL '30' DAY FROM pipeline_run_summary) GROUP BY created_at ORDER BY created_at
SELECT created_at AS time, task_name, duration_sec FROM pipeline_run_summary WHERE created_at >= (SELECT MAX(created_at) - INTERVAL '30' DAY FROM pipeline_run_summary) ORDER BY created_at, task_name
SELECT created_at, pipeline_name, task_name, status, duration_sec, processed_rows, target_table, error_message, run_id FROM pipeline_run_summary ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100
